note: One entry per unique asset key. A product sold by several branches of the same vendor is one file that lists every entity using it.

styleGuide.look: Clean, realistic, appetising commerce imagery for an Egyptian (Belbeis, Sharqia) delivery marketplace. Soft natural studio light, shallow shadow, neutral warm off-white background (#FAFAFA to #F4EFEA), one clear hero subject, true-to-life colours.
mustNot: no text, captions, prices, watermarks or UI chrome baked into the image
no real-world brand logos or trademarked packaging (use generic, unbranded packaging)
no people or hands unless the brief says so
no borders, rounded-corner masks or drop frames (the app applies its own radius/circle crop)
styleGuide.format: webp, sRGB, quality ~80; tiles < 150 KB, product images < 300 KB
styleGuide.cropSafety: The app crops with BoxFit.cover: keep the subject centred and fully inside the central square; leave edge margin.
